versions.changelog:
## Seasonal Care Packages 1.0

First release.

- Four letters with a small parcel, one per season, on day 10: Evelyn in spring, Gus in summer, Caroline in fall and Marnie in winter.
- Each parcel holds one of three small seasonal surprises, such as seeds, forage or a cold treat. No money.
- A letter only comes once you have met its sender.

## Seasonal Care Packages 1.1

Now in German too.

- All four letters and their titles are translated into German. Players with the game set to German get the German letters; everyone else keeps the English ones.
- Same senders, same parcels, same day 10 of each season; nothing else changes.
